name: WindowAction
description:
One window action with a priority (see the module comment). Outside `Window.Actions` or a
frame's `actions` it renders its children as they are.
signature: ({ label, icon, priority, onSelect, disabled, menu, children }: WindowActionProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The action as it shows in the app bar: a ghost sm Button, a Segmented, a Menu trigger.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The More menu item is disabled.

props.name: icon
props.description: The item's icon in the More menu.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the action as an item in the More menu once it has folded away.

props.name: menu
props.description:
The action's own content for the More menu, in place of one item: a submenu
(`Menu.Submenu`) for an action that opens a menu, radio items for a Segmented choice.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with no arguments when the person chooses the action from the More menu.

props.name: priority
props.description:
`secondary` (the default) folds into the More menu when the app bar runs out of room,
the last ones first; `primary` always stays in the bar.
